noctty 1.3.139

- Updates without a server: drop update.zip beside noctty.exe and noctty
  offers it at the next start (what's new, Update or Ignore).
- Automatic update checks over the internet are off.
- Remote Desktop tabs are named after their connection, and use the Remote
  Desktop control this Windows really serves.
- Remote Desktop quality: colors, compression and visual quality in
  Settings > Shell, and per connection in its window.
- Settings > Profiles: one row per profile; Enter opens its window (name,
  command, starting folder, zoom, open as administrator, variables), new
  profiles based on detected ones, and Delete.
- Tab menu: Create Profile from This Tab.
- Window menu: Back up all settings (.zip), passwords included.
- Settings > Shell: Starting folder.
